definitions.explanation: A physical item or product, especially one for sale or trade. General term for merchandise or objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{品物|しなもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いくら→幾ら：00943_ikura⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{品物|しなもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りました→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{品物|しなもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}えません→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
{品物|しなもの} is a general term for physical goods or items, often used in shopping and business contexts.

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- {品物|しなもの}: physical goods/items (slightly formal)
- ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: thing (general, casual)
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: product, merchandise (commercial focus)
- ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: manufactured product

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {品物|しなもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose an item
- {品物|しなもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to deliver goods
- {品物|しなもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send goods
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{品物|しなもの}: expensive items

USAGE:
{品物|しなもの} emphasizes the tangible, physical nature of items. It's more formal than ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ but less commercial than ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧.
